messages.content: Difficulty L3. A sibling task uses exactly one stable transformation rule. Examples: [1, 2, 3]->[3, 5, 7] ; [4, 5, 6]->[9, 11, 13] ; [7, 8, 9]->[15, 17, 19] ; [10, 11, 12]->[21, 23, 25]. Candidate distractor rules include: subtract 1 from every number; sort ascending; multiply by 3; rotate left then subtract 2; replace each value by its index. Infer the rule from the examples and apply it to [16, 18, 21]. Return only the transformed numbers comma-separated.
